newsitem.title: BELGIUM: W.European all-freighter traffic share up in July.
newsitem.headline: W.European all-freighter traffic share up in July.

text.p: Global freight traffic shipped by West European airlines on all-cargo aircraft rose by 1.7 percentage points in July 1996 on the same month last year, the Association of European Airlines (AEA) told Reuters.
Global freight traffic carried by West European airlines in July 1996 was up 3.2 percent on the same month last year at 1.95 billion freight tonne-kilometres, FTK, AEA figures showed.
The FTK measurement is derived by multiplying the weight of cargo carried by the distance flown.
In the month in question, airlines' full-freighter services accounted for 35.6 percent of the global volume of traffic flown compared to 33.9 percent in July 1995.
On Europe-Far East/Australasia routes, the volume of traffic transported by full-freighters in July this year remained stable on 1995 levels at 46.2 percent.
On Europe-North America air cargo routes, the volume of traffic shipped on full freighter services increased by 0.1 percentage points on July 1995 to 25.1 percent.

Full-freighters increased their share of global traffic on Middle East routes by 5.1 percentage points to 50.3 percent, 9.9 percentage points on South Atlantic routes to 43.7 percent and on African routes by 8.2 percentage points to 38.5 percent, AEA added.
By contrast the percentage share of global traffic shipped on Mid-Atlantic routes, on all-cargo aircraft slipped by 7.5 percentage points to 19.8 percent.
